name: AIR-Bench 2024 (AI Safety Benchmark)
description: The first AI safety benchmark aligned with government regulations and company policies. Decomposes 8 government regulations and 16 company policies into a four-tiered safety taxonomy with 314 granular risk categories. Contains 5,694 diverse prompts designed to test LLM compliance across these risk categories, with three-level scoring (1 = refusal, 0.5 = ambiguous, 0 = harmful assistance).
typical_sota_score: significant variability across 314 risk categories; no single model achieves full compliance
reputation: Developed by Stanford CRFM and collaborators; evaluated 21 LLMs; results on HELM portal; CC-BY-4.0 dataset, Apache 2.0 code
notes: Distinct from AIR-Bench audio benchmark (ACL 2024). Unique in grounding safety taxonomy in actual government regulations. Four-tiered taxonomy enables granular analysis by risk category. Dataset on Hugging Face.
